Sequoia Wording Guide

One word per idea and one button system for the Sequoia menu, in English and Egyptian Arabic. Built from the live site's styles and texts, so what you see here is what guests see.

Terms

IdeaEnglishArabicNotes
The whole list of drinksMenuالمنيوNot "list", "catalogue".
A part of the menu (Hot Drinks…)section · track in the cassette themeقسم · تراك"Track" only in the mixtape decoration; screen readers get "Menu sections".
One drink or dessertitem (only in counts: "15 items")صنفNever "product".
MoneyEGP, after the number on the page footer: "All prices in EGP"جنيهPrices are whole numbers, no decimals.
The person who takes orderscaptainالكابتنNever "waiter" or "server".
The guest's tableTable 7ترابيزة 7Number comes from the QR; guests never type it.

Decline a promptNot nowمش دلوقتي

Writing rules

  • Buttons start with a verb and say what happens: "Ask for the bill", "Request song", "Read the journal". Never "OK", "Submit", "Click here". Option buttons (Cash, Water) are the exception: they are the choice itself.
  • Capitals: only for short labels of 1–3 words in the cassette style (MENU, SIDE A, PLAY IT AGAIN). Sentences, statuses and errors are sentence case.
  • Errors say what happened and what to do: "Couldn't reach the captain. Check your connection and try again."
  • Short: labels 1–3 words; helper lines one sentence.
  • Numbers in Arabic screens stay Western digits (7, 45) to match the printed menu and the table QR.
  • No invented claims ("healthy", "best"). Allergens, when added, use "Contains: milk, nuts" / "يحتوي على: لبن، مكسرات".

Button kinds

KindUseLook
Primarythe one main action on a screen (Ready to order, Press play, Request song)filled; accent red or cream on navy, navy in light sheets
Secondaryan alternative next to the primary (Other requests, Rewind)outline
Linkleave or skip (Back to menu, Not now)underlined text
Optionpick one of several (Cash / Card, Water)white tile; dashed after it was sent

Every button, every state

Hover (on a computer) makes filled buttons slightly brighter. Touch targets are at least 44 × 44 px with 8 px between buttons. There is no TV layout: Sequoia has no in-store screens.

Primary · cover

The one main action on the cover.

Primary · Ready to order

Bottom bar on every menu screen. Calls the captain at once.

Secondary · Other requests

Next to Ready to order. Outline, so Ready stays the one primary.

Status · request sent

Shown for a minute after a request. A sentence, not capitals.

Option · sheet

Pick one of several (payment, quick requests). Dashed once sent.

Primary · sheet

Main action inside a light sheet.

Link

Leave or skip. Underlined text.

Primary · song card

Request a song, at the bottom of the cover page.

Navigation · next / previous section

Bottom of each menu section.

Section chips

Jump between menu sections. Current one is filled.
